body: ADVISOR'S RULINGS ON THE P2-12 PLAN (14 Nov 2026, lead). D1 ACCEPTED: no catalogue on a plain music server or an Encore server without the `catalogue` feature (the D-51 lyrics precedent, ADR-R38); `DeezerClient` stays a RECORDED STOP-GAP until slice 7. D2: D-51 (docs/10-decisions-needed.md) says 'lyrics first (P2-14), then the catalogue (P2-12)... nothing of either merges before the release-candidate walk record b11'; b11 is not started. So the hold covers P2-12: SLICE 1 (server, additive, nothing calls it) and SLICE 4 (a drawing) may merge now; slices 2, 3, 5-8 are built ONLY as DRAFTS and are not opened until the lead says. D3 ACCEPTED: P2-12b is split: YouTube Music as a second source is item N-29 (Later), 'catalogue pictures come through your server' is item N-30 (Now, after N-28); the proposal parser only reads ids like N-29. D4 ACCEPTED and acted on: P2-12 NEEDS P2-25 (the server's name folding is ASCII-only, B-37: non-Latin artists would get no identity), so slices 3 (identity) and 5 (typo) wait for P2-25 or carry its fix first; slice 1 may start; check P2-25's size, it may be the next job right after slice 1. D5 ACCEPTED: the shipped N-23a numbers ('Corn' is not 'Korn'; only symbol-for-letter look-alikes cost 0): the N-23b note of 14 Nov 11:01 is replaced by a note on N-23. RECORDINGS: the lead recorded the real Deezer answers (11 requests, spaced) in handoff-2026-11-03/recordings-14nov/deezer_p212/; only the error answers (429, quota, timeout) may be synthetic. VENV TRAP: C:/dev/venv-encore-server had `encore_server` installed from the OLD archive clone; fixed 14 Nov (editable install from the live clone's main); a worktree's tests must run from its own server/encore_server with `python -m pytest` (NOT `python -I`, which drops the current directory and imports main), after printing `encore_server.__file__`. GO: slice 1 only (the Deezer gate, its cache file, the catalogue routes, the cover and artist finders moved onto the gate; its tests must show B-124 and B-127 unchanged).
